name: GlideCurrencyValue
title: GlideCurrencyValue - Scoped
summary: The GlideCurrencyValue API provides methods that return the currency code and original currency from an associated GlideCurrencyParser.parse() call.
overview:
This API is provided within the sn_currency namespace.

Note:
There is no constructor for this class.

members.name: getAmount
members.summary: Returns the currency amount originally passed into the associated GlideCurrencyParser.parse() call.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String Original currency passed into the parse() method.

This example shows how to call the method.

var gp = new sn_currency.GlideCurrencyParser(); 
gp.setLocale("eng", "USA");  
var cv = gp.parse("USD;1234.56"); 
gs.info('Original currency amount: ' + cv.getAmount());

Output:

Original currency amount: 1234.56

members.name: getCurrencyCode
members.summary: Returns the currency code used to parse the currency in the associated GlideCurrencyParser.parse() call.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String Three-letter ISO currency code used to parse the currency.

This example shows how to call the method.

var gp = new sn_currency.GlideCurrencyParser(); 
gp.setLocale(eng, USA); 
var cv = gp.parse("USD";"1234.56"); 
gs.info('Parsed currency code: ' + cv.getCurrencyCode());

Output:

Parsed currency code: USD
